# Fixtures

Public test data and deterministic fixtures. Never store private keys.

- `abi-v1.ts` and `abi-v1.sha256`: the shared Rust/TypeScript hash vectors.
- `agents.ts`: example agent metadata.
- `verification.ts`: SIMULATED verification results for fixture providers.
- `policies.ts`: the SOW example wallet policy and keyless example addresses for SDK policy tests.
